name: Triangle Flip
description: The picture is cut into a mosaic of triangles that turn over in perspective in a wave spreading from a point, each one rolling away from it about one of its three axes, catching a glint of light and casting a soft shadow, and showing its part of the second clip on its back. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of rows of triangles across the height of the frame

params.name: center
params.description: Point the wave of flips spreads from (0..1, y down)

params.name: stagger
params.description: How long the wave takes to cross the frame, as a part of the transition: 0 turns every triangle at once

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the light and shadows on the turning triangles and of the shade in the holes they leave
